title: Joomla Extension - jdownloads.com - IDOR allowing restricted file downloads in jDownloads < 4.1.8 - The other_file_id…
description: An Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability exists in the Joomla extension jDownloads versions prior to 4.1.8. The vulnerability allows unauthorized users to download restricted files by manipulating the 'other_file_id' parameter, bypassing access controls intended to protect those files.
